metadata.intent:
Build a reusable test-first bugfix workflow for this repository. Accept a bug
report, reproduction expectations, a branch name, and the repository root
directory. Abort unless the checkout is clean, switch to main,
fast-forward-only pull the latest changes and stop without changing the
worktree if that fails, then create the branch.

Inspect the owning module and reproduce the bug with the smallest failing test
before editing production code. Diagnose the failure from evidence, then ask
the human to approve starting agent-driven remediation, stating the diagnosis
and the failing test as evidence. Only after approval, use Codex or Claude
Code to implement the fix in the appropriate module and rerun the focused
test until it passes. This AGENT_CALL requires the experimental agent-steps
setting to be enabled and an authenticated Codex or Claude Code account
selected; abort with that requirement if it is not.

Then apply the `principal-developer` skill
(`skills/principal-developer/SKILL.md`) as a review gate, run `cargo fmt
--check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo
test --all-targets --all-features`, and all ignored `live_spec_planning`
tests, fixing findings and repeating relevant checks until clean. Confirm the
diff carries no credentials, personal data, proprietary third-party code, or
license-incompatible generated material. Prepare a pull-request title and
body with the regression evidence, why the fix is needed, and any follow-up
work, ask the human to approve publication, and only after approval push and
create the pull request with `gh` CLI.

plan.name: test_first_rust_bugfix_and_pull_request
plan.description: Creates a clean feature branch, adds a minimal failing regression test, obtains approval for agent-driven remediation, verifies the fix through bounded retries and principal-developer review, and publishes an approved pull request.

inputs.name: bug_report
inputs.description: Description of the observed bug and its impact

inputs.name: reproduction_expectations
inputs.description: Expected reproduction scenario and correct behavior

inputs.name: branch_name
inputs.description: Feature branch to create for the bugfix

inputs.name: root_directory
inputs.description: Root directory of the Rust repository

steps.name: Verify clean checkout and create branch
steps.description: Inspects tracked and untracked changes, switches to main, performs a fast-forward-only pull, restores the original branch if the pull fails, and creates the requested branch only after success.

config.inline:
set -euo pipefail
branch="$BRANCH_NAME"
base="$BASE_BRANCH"
remote="$REMOTE_NAME"
git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null
original_branch="$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD)" || { echo 'Refusing to proceed from a detached HEAD.' >&2; exit 1; }
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)" ]; then
  echo 'Checkout is not clean; tracked or untracked changes are present.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git check-ref-format --branch "$branch" >/dev/null
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"; then
  echo "Local branch already exists: $branch" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git switch "$base"
if ! git pull --ff-only "$remote" "$base"; then
  restore_status=0
  git switch "$original_branch" || restore_status=$?
  if [ "$restore_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Fast-forward-only pull failed, and restoring $original_branch also failed." >&2
  else
    echo "Fast-forward-only pull failed; restored $original_branch without creating $branch." >&2
  fi
  exit 1
fi
git switch -c "$branch"
printf 'Clean checkout verified; updated %s/%s with fast-forward-only semantics and created %s.\n' "$remote" "$base" "$branch"

steps.name: Investigate and add the failing regression
steps.description: Requires experimental agent steps and an authenticated Codex or Claude Code account. Failure to launch must abort with that prerequisite.

steps.name: Require the regression to fail before remediation
Decide whether focused remediation is complete
Apply principal-developer review and compliance gate

config.objective: Act as a read-only review gate for retry attempt ${item.attempt}. Locate and completely read skills/principal-developer/SKILL.md and apply it to review the entire branch diff against main. Do not edit files and do not run the cargo acceptance commands, because typed steps perform those checks. Inspect tracked, staged, and untracked changes. Identify correctness, architecture, maintainability, testing, observability, or repository-convention findings. Also confirm whether the complete diff contains no credentials, secrets, personal data, proprietary third-party code, or license-incompatible generated material. Treat uncertainty or inability to locate/apply the skill as failure. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: success (true only when there are no review or compliance findings), findings (array of concise actionable strings), and compliance_confirmation (concise audit statement).

steps.name: Repeat review and validation until clean

config.system_prompt: You write concise, factual pull-request metadata. Return strict JSON only, with no Markdown fence.

steps.name: Decide whether the branch is clean

outputs.name: pull_request_url
outputs.description: URL of the approved and published pull request
